units.source_text: 如果有为子不在，随便谁都可以。

en.t: If Uiko was not there, anyone would do.

units.source_text: 要是或选择或期待，就必然失败，我是残存着这样一种迷信。

en.t: I still clung to the superstition that if I chose someone, or expected anything, I was bound to fail.

units.source_text: 如同烟花女没有挑客人的余地一样，我也不挑选女人才是啊。

en.t: Just as a prostitute has no room to choose her customers, I too ought not to choose women.

units.source_text: 必须让那个可怕的使人失去气力的美的观念丝毫没有介人的余地。

en.t: I had to leave no room at all for that terrible idea of beauty, the one that drained a person of strength, to intrude.
